english.title: Keep / use embryo without licence/third party agreement - Human Fertilisation and Embryology Act 1990

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Human Fertilisation and Embryology Quality and Safety Regulations 2007

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) kept or used an embryo otherwise than in pursuance of a licence or a third party agreement in accordance with section 3(1A) of the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Act 1990
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 3(1A), 41(2)(a) and (4) of the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Act 1990.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
kept/used an embryo
otherwise than in pursuance of a licence/ third party agreement
in accordance with section 3(1A) of the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Act 1990

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence was introduced into the Act by Regulation 8 of the Human Fertilisation and Embryology (Quality and Safety) Regulations 2007 (SI 2007/1522).

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
